## 1. Executive Summary & Architectural Overview

Phase 3 of OpenFlightReader delivers the export, visualization, and application layer on top of `flightreader-core`. The core engine (`flightreader-core`, delivered in Phases 1 and 2) produces asynchronous, strongly-typed telemetry records:
- **OSD Telemetry (Record Type 1)**: Primary navigation cadence (~10 Hz).
